gql: MATCH (n:Person {id: $personId})-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(p:City) RETURN n.firstName AS firstName, n.lastName AS lastName, n.birthday AS birthday, n.locationIP AS locationIP, n.browserUsed AS browserUsed, p.id AS cityId, n.gender AS gender, n.creationDate AS creationDate  -- {"personId": Int(3)}
expected: [[String("Cy"), String("Ng"), Date(1985-07-07), String("10.0.0.3"), String("Safari"), Int(10), String("male"), Int(120)]]

gql: MATCH (message:Post)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(person:Person {id: $personId}) RETURN message.id AS messageId, COALESCE(message.imageFile, message.content) AS messageContent, message.creationDate AS messageCreationDate, message.id AS postId, person.id AS personId, person.firstName AS personFirstName, person.lastName AS personLastName ORDER BY messageCreationDate DESC, messageId ASC  -- {"personId": Int(1)}
expected: [[Int(101), String("photo.jpg"), Int(310), Int(101), Int(1), String("Ana"), String("Silva")], [Int(100), String("first post"), Int(300), Int(100), Int(1), String("Ana"), String("Silva")]]

gql: MATCH (n:Person {id: $personId})-[r:KNOWS]->(friend:Person) RETURN friend.id AS personId, friend.firstName AS firstName, friend.lastName AS lastName, r.creationDate AS friendshipCreationDate ORDER BY friendshipCreationDate DESC, personId ASC  -- {"personId": Int(4)}
expected: [[Int(2), String("Bo"), String("Lind"), Int(220)], [Int(3), String("Cy"), String("Ng"), Int(205)]]
